data.desc: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. (Nasdaq: RDHL) is a specialty biopharmaceutical company primarily focused on U.S. development and commercialization of drugs for gastrointestinal diseases, infectious diseases and oncology. RedHill promotes the FDA-approved gastrointestinal therapies Rebyota , for the prevention of recurrent C. diff infection (rCDI), and the bowel preparation treatment, Clenpiq .
